In Re:-
Case :- CRIMINAL REVISION No. - 293 of 2003 Revisionist :- Moti Lal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.

Counsel for Revisionist :- R.A.Mishra,A.K.Misra,Aditya K. Shukla,Kalika Prasad Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
Heard Sri K.P. Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant/ revisionist and the learned Additional Government Advocate for the State on the application for correction of order dated 13.07.2018.

By means of this application, the learned counsel for the revisionist has prayed that inadvertently due to typographical error the judgment which was dictated in the open court was not properly transcribed, therefore, the judgment / order dated 13.07.2018 may be corrected in the interested of justice.
I have perused the contents of the application as well as the judgment and order dated 13.07.2018 passed by this Court and I find that the correction so prayed deserves to be made in the order.

sentences.text: In the second line of para-6 of the order, it has been indicated that the learned counsel for the revisionist is seeking benefit of provisions of Offenders Act, 1958 whereas the submission of learned counsel for the revisionist was that the revisionist has already undergone the imprisonment of more than two months and for the rest of the sentence a reasonable fine be awarded by reducing the same keeping in view the facts and circumstances of the case.

Likewise, para-7 of the said order has also not properly been transcribed inasmuch as the revisionist has already undergone the imprisonment of more than two months and the incident is about 27 years old, therefore, the rest of the conviction period is converted into the punishment of fine.

Likewise, in the last paragraph of order it has been indicated that the revisionist shall submit the necessary bonds in terms of the provisions of Offenders Act, 1958 before the trial court within a period of one month, whereas since the revisionist has not been given the benefit of provisions of Offenders Act, 1958, therefore, such requirement is not necessary for the revisionist.

Accordingly, the application is allowed and the order dated 13.07.2018 is hereby corrected as under:-
Para-6 of the order
says that the learned counsel for the revisionist is praying
the benefit of the provisions of Offenders Act, 1958 would be read as under:-

"In view of the aforesaid submission, learned counsel for the revisionist has submitted that the sentence of the revisionist may be confined to the extent of fine only by reducing his remaining period of sentence."

The para-7 of the order would be read as under:-
"I have considered the rival submissions of learned counsel for the parties and I am of the view that in view of the fact that the incident in question is about 27 years old and the revisionist has already undergone more than two months imprisonment,
therefore, the period of sentence is hereby reduced to the period which has already undergone by the revisionist."
The last paragraph of order is deleted.

However in place of it, the following would be read as under:-
"The conviction order dated 07.03.2000, passed by the Ist Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Sultanpur in Criminal Case No.2034 of 1992, under Sections 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is hereby upheld subject to the modification as indicated here-in-above.
Let the lower court record be returned back to the court concerned along with certified copy of this order within a period of fifteen days from today.

sentences.text: No order as to cost."
The Court has noticed that in the memo of Criminal Revision the date of order of the trail court is indicated as 07.03.2003 whereas it is 07.03.2000.

Since it has wrongly been indicated in the memo of criminal revision as 07.03.2003, therefore, it has been transcribed in the order dated 13.07.2018 of this Court as 07.03.2003, but in any case in the entire order of this court dated 13.07.2018 it would be read as 07.03.2000 in place of 07.03.2003.

Since one month period was granted to the revisionist to deposit the amount of fine before the court below w.e.f. 13.07.2018, which has been lapsed, therefore, the revisionist is now granted three weeks further time from today to deposit the amount of Rs.5000/- in the trial court.
The order dated 13.07.2018 has been corrected accordingly.

Order Date :- 21.8.2018 Suresh/ [Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.]
